p1_goal_flood_duplicate.meaning: Prove that the exact generated witness is invalid, not that the original theorem is false. The unused inner k loop repeats every list element four times.
p1_goal_flood_duplicate.source:
Require Import List Arith.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Definition proposed_witness : list nat := (flat_map (fun i => flat_map (fun j => flat_map (fun k => map (fun t => 125 * 2 ^ i * 3 ^ j * 7 ^ t) (seq 0 2)) (seq 1 4)) (seq 1 4)) (seq 3 6)).
Theorem proposed_witness_has_duplicates : ~ NoDup proposed_witness.
Proof.
  intro H.
  unfold proposed_witness in H.
  cbn [flat_map seq map app] in H.
  inversion H as [|x xs Hnot Htail]; subst.
  apply Hnot.
  right; left; reflexivity.
Qed.
Print Assumptions proposed_witness_has_duplicates.

p1_goal_flood_duplicate_symbolic.meaning: Symbolic proof that the exact saved witness contains a duplicate. The earlier concrete inversion overflow is preserved; the benchmark worker is not modified.
p1_goal_flood_duplicate_symbolic.source:
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope nat_scope.
Lemma duplicate_head (A : Type) (x y : A) (tl : list A) :
  ~ NoDup (x :: y :: x :: tl).
Proof.
  intro H.
  inversion H as [|a rest Hnot Htail]; subst.
  apply Hnot.
  right; left; reflexivity.
Qed.
Definition proposed_witness : list nat := (flat_map (fun i => flat_map (fun j => flat_map (fun k => map (fun t => 125 * 2 ^ i * 3 ^ j * 7 ^ t) (seq 0 2)) (seq 1 4)) (seq 1 4)) (seq 3 6)).
Theorem proposed_witness_has_duplicates : ~ NoDup proposed_witness.
Proof.
  unfold proposed_witness.
  apply duplicate_head.
Qed.
Print Assumptions proposed_witness_has_duplicates.
